content: An'kab kàpɛ un'kweel un'dim wàŋàlàmbwà
Yàmɛnà naa ilä mwɛy, mpal kàkäl Yɛsu muler, nde kàmɛn aŋin'naaŋ bàmusà an'kab aba uboo a insak a an'kab.
Nde kàmɛn sye un'kweel un'dim mwyɛ wàŋàlàmbwà wàmusà an'falà mɔ̈ɔ̈l.
Nde kàtɛn naa: « Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään: un'kweel un'dim wàŋàlàmbwà wà kan'pà yàŋàsöön baar banswà.
Ntɔn baar bumwɛy banswà ban'pà ngim ikɔ̈ɔ̈n ndöŋ akà ba, wɛɛ nde, unsà làmbwà ande, nde kan'pà yinà yanswà ikäl ntɔn mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande. »
Yɛsu kan'kyään mpää a ndwà a Nzam
Ilä mwɛy, baar amwɛy bàkäl mukan in'kul anà indiir byàpɛɛ ntwɛn a ndwà a Nzam, wɛɛ Yɛsu kàtɛn naa:
« Ilä byà paa mpa usàsaal akà un'kul mwɛy udu a un'kul wumwɛy uboo a bya làmanà bɛ bi: bya byanswà byàsàkyer apää. »
Ngyɛb anà nkwaaŋ
Apan ba waa bun'fuul naa: « Un'lɔɔŋ, ndaa ayi isàlyaaŋ mpal nà? Undiir nà asàswaŋ ngyeel a ndaa ayi? »
Yɛsu kàfuur naa: « Làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ, mbuur twon amàlakur. Ntɔn baar mbɔɔn bàsàyà kà ikɔb amɛ, waa bàsàtɛn naa: "Mɛ in'wà Klistɔ!" Anà: "Taaŋ lan'kwo!" Wɛɛ twon làmalab.
Mpal làsàwem bɛ naa ità anà lingyoomà byan'yà, twon lan'man bɔɔmà: yubwaŋ naa bya itàyà abun kusà, wɛɛ bya kà ntsüü anki. »
Apan nde waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Isàmɛnà naa nsi mwɛy yàmunwan anà nsi yumwɛy, imwol mwɛy anà imwol kyumwɛy.
Mɛɛn ikyer asàtɛɛr ngwal. Kà ikal mbɔɔn ngyal mbɔɔn anà an'fway màkyer asàbilà, ndaa a bɔɔmà yà ifà ifà ikyer asàtoo, idiim a kölàköl byàkyer asàmɛnà u du.

Wɛɛ kusà a ndaa ayi yanswà, bàkyer asàlakɔr, bàkyer asàlamɛɛy nkwaaŋ, bàkyer asàlasyen u làbay a nsaŋ a amfum a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà, waa bàsàlatɔɔm u bɔlokà. Ntɔn ikɔb amɛ, bàkyer asàlasyen akà amfum a nsi anà akà amfum a itiir a nsi.
Indiir abi byanswà isàlayeel ntɔn bɛ làkäl anà mbwo mutà imbäl.
Twon lan'yweer kusà naa bɛ làkyer aben musàsà un'lɔɔn abɛ.
Mɛ ŋakwo in'kyer asàlapà ndaa anà an'yeerà mpa bàsàtɔn ayiiŋ abɛ itàkal musà mbaaŋ.
Baar bàsàlayälà bà aböör anà atɔŋ abɛ, baar a tsütsü a bɛ anà asam abɛ, ba bàsàdwa baar mbɔɔn uboo a bɛ.
Baar banswà bàkyer asàlayiiŋ ntɔn mɛ.
Wɛɛ akà làtswe abɛ làmwɛy làsàdiimà anki.
Abun, ntɔn nkääŋ a mpem abɛ, bɛ làsàwà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Yɛsu kan'kyään mpää a Yɛlusàlɛm
« Wɛɛ mpal làsàman bɛ naa aŋità ban'diŋà Yɛlusàlɛm, apan làyöb naa mpää a la yà tsütsü.
Apan, wɛy baar a Yuday bàtiin udu a myɔŋ. Wɛy baar abà u Yɛlusàlɛm bàtoo agyägyä. Wɛy baar abà u bitsuŋ a ndwà bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n abilà u bul a kölàköl!
Ntɔn ilä abin isàkal ilä a bweel, ntɔn Ndaa Aŋàsɔn yanswà ikwe.
Ngyɛb akà akaar bàsàkal anà an'yöm anà akaar bàsàkal munüü baan ilä abin! Ntɔn ntaan isàkal uboo a nsi yi, anà nkyɛl ntɔn un'sɛŋ wà.
Baar a nsi yi bàsadwa a kɔm, bumwɛy bàsasyen asɔ u nsi a ingyey, wɛ Yɛlusàlɛm làsàbulà là baar mpa bàyöb Nzam tii mpal isàwà isɔ.
Ngyeel a Mwan a mbuur
« Idiim ikyer asàkal uboo a taaŋ, uboo a nsöŋ anà unsà mbwaar. U mɛɛn baar banswà bàsàkal mutɛɛr a bɔɔmà ntɔn làso anà ibɔ a an'dà a ngyäl.
Lalan baar mbɔɔn bàsàkwà a bɔɔmà muyweer ndaa isàbwà u mɛɛn manswà, ntɔn ngwal a du yanswà ikyer asàni.
Apan, baar bàsàman Mwan a mbuur wàmuyà uboo a itööm unsà ngwal anà làkoo mbɔɔn.
Taaŋ isàlyaŋ ndaa ayi yanswà, làsuub un'tswe anà làsi un'kanà, ntɔn ntsuuŋ abɛ isàkal tsütsü. »
Ndaa ulɔɔŋà un'te a maŋ
Apan Yɛsu katɛɛl nsim yi: « Làler un'te a maŋ anà in'te myanswà:
Bɛ làsàman naa mya myan'fulà, bɛ lan'yöb bɛ ŋakwo naa paŋà a mbul là tsütsü.
Ya sye yabun mpal làsàman bɛ naa ndaa ayi yan'yà, làyöb naa Imwol a Nzam kyà tsütsü.
Mɛ ndandaa alàkyään, nkööl ayi isàlyaŋ anki kusà a ndaa ayi yanswà mukwo.
Du anà mɛɛn màkyer asàlyaaŋ, wɛɛ ndaa amɛ isàlyaaŋ anki akà ikikye.
Mfun mukal kà ikyɛɛŋ
« Làkäl kà ikyɛɛŋ bɛ ŋakwo ntɔn an'kyän abɛ màkɔ̈ɔ̈n abwà mpye ntɔn udyà mbɔɔn, unwà mbɔɔn anà ngyɛb ntɔn indiir a mɛɛn mà, naa tɛy, ilä aki isàyàlataan kà imbwirà imbwirà.
Ntɔn kya isàbwà asànaa an'tɛy udu a baar a mɛɛn banswà.
Làkäl kà ikyɛɛŋ, làyamà taaŋ lanswà, ntɔn bɛ làkäl anà ngwal mutiin ndaa iyà yi yanswà anà musàkal umbär kusà a Mwan a mbuur. »
U mwäänà Yɛsu kàlɔɔŋà u ndwà a Nzam, wɛ sisye nde kàkyeenà mukàtyeey taaŋ u mɔŋ bàfàbel naa mɔŋ a in'te a ɔlive.
Ututu tutu, un'sɛŋ wanswà kàkyeenà akà nde u ndwà a Nzam ntɔn mukun'wem.
